symbols.name: address field group H
symbols.meaning: The first of the two ordered groups of address fields, viewed as a vector over a common residue ring.
symbols.quote: Here $H$ and $D$ are the two ordered groups of address fields, viewed as vectors over a common residue ring (the integers with arithmetic taken modulo a fixed number).

symbols.name: address field group D
symbols.meaning: The second of the two ordered groups of address fields, viewed as a vector over a common residue ring.
symbols.quote: Here $H$ and $D$ are the two ordered groups of address fields, viewed as vectors over a common residue ring (the integers with arithmetic taken modulo a fixed number).

symbols.name: shear matrix
symbols.meaning: The rational matrix of the shear, with one row for each field of H and one column for each field of D.
symbols.quote: $A$ is a rational matrix with one row for each field of $H$ and one column for each field of $D$, so that $AD$ has the length of $H$.

relations.quote: The shear is based on [Lower-triangular factorization](lower-triangular-factorization.md), which writes $A = E_1\Pi E_2$ with $E_1$ and $E_2$ invertible lower-triangular and $\Pi$ a partial permutation matrix with one 1 per pivot.

The shear is realized in a [Linear network with restored auxiliary values](linear-network-exchange.md), which restores every auxiliary value it uses, so the array holds only the updated fields when the shear ends.
